title: BERM parameter registry record
description: One row of data/registry/parameter_registry.csv. Enforced by berm.data.registry.validate_parameter_registry. Every constant that changes a prediction belongs here, graded honestly.

value.description: Literal value, or a pointer such as 'see countries.py:205' for table-valued parameters, or 'fitted_at_runtime' / 'fitted_per_country' for calibration outputs.

unit.description: Required. A dimensionless parameter states 'dimensionless', never nothing.

prior_or_range.description: Either '[lo, hi]' or 'see <file>:<line>'. A parameter with no range cannot be varied in a sensitivity analysis and therefore cannot be falsified.

evidence_grade.description: MEASURED: taken from a cited measurement of this quantity. ESTIMATED: fitted or derived from data. SCENARIO: chosen by the modeller as an assumption. UNIDENTIFIED: present in the code with no recorded origin.

scope.description: Which geographies and years the value applies to.

active_model_version.description: Which model version consumes it: v17-legacy, v16, v17-asfr, diagnostic, or a semicolon-separated combination.

defined_in.description: file:line where the value lives, so the registry and the code can be checked against each other.

affects.description: Which stage it changes: E_ambient, E_personal, E_night, E_developmental, R_reproductive, D_demand, ASFR, TFR, or a diagnostic output.

then.description: A MEASURED parameter must not point at a scenario placeholder source. Cross-registry rule, enforced in registry.validate_parameter_registry.
An assumption must not point at a source registered OBSERVED or PROXY. Cross-registry rule, enforced in registry.validate_parameter_registry.
